name: Necklace of Adaptation
description: A fine chain of silver links with a glass bubble for a pendant.
body:
## What it does

While you wear it you breathe normally anywhere, even underwater or in a vacuum, and harmful gases and vapours struggle to affect you.

advantages.name: Saving throws
advantages.note: against harmful gases and vapours, such as cloudkill and stinking cloud

features.name: Breath
features.text: You can breathe normally in any environment.
